input.command: python -c 'from pathlib import Path; import re, subprocess; from docx import Document; from docx.oxml.ns import qn; from docx.text.paragraph import Paragraph; from docx.table import Table; head="5747fb6f85829b2c72edbba3101ee922ee508da2"; paths=["outputs/growth-plan.md","outputs/growth-plan.docx"]; assert all(Path(p).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show",head+":"+p]) for p in paths); text=Path(paths[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"); assert text==Path("artifacts/marketing-growth/campaign-plan.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"); expected=[]; actual=[]; d=Document(paths[1]); [(expected.append([x.strip() for x in line.strip("|").split("|")]) if line.startswith("|") else expected.append(re.sub(r"^#+\s+","",line))) for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not (line.startswith("|") and all(re.fullmatch(r":?-+:?",x.strip()) for x in line.strip("|").split("|")))]; [(actual.append(Paragraph(c,d).text) if c.tag==qn("w:p") else actual.extend([[v.text for v in r.cells] for r in Table(c,d).rows])) for c in d.element.body if c.tag in [qn("w:p"),qn("w:tbl")]]; assert expected==actual; assert all(s.page_width<s.page_height for s in d.sections); print("Business files equal exact committed bytes; mirror Unicode body equal (Windows CRLF versus LF only); MD/DOCX ordered blocks:",len(actual),"; tables:",len(d.tables),"; all sections portrait")'
